newsitem.title: FINLAND: Strong Nokia, forestries take Helsinki higher.
newsitem.headline: Strong Nokia, forestries take Helsinki higher.

text.p: Share indices were higher on Wednesday afternoon, with moderately active trade dominated by Nokia, which gained further to outpace its higher overnight Wall Street close boosted by earnings upgrades, brokers said.
Nokia hit a life-high 488.00 markka, up 16.10, recovering from a brief bout of profit-taking after it reported slightly higher than expected H1 earnings on Monday.
"The profit-taking was minor," one broker said. He and others pointed to recent earnings upgrades by many big brokerages. "In two weeks it (Nokia's share price) will break 500 markka," another said.
Forestries were well traded ahead of their forthcoming interim results. Metsa-Serla was at 47.70 markka, up 1.30 markka. It is due to release its H1 result on Thursday morning.
Enso was flat at 49.00 markka. Enso's H1 results are due next Wednesday. UPM-Kymmene rose 0.70 markka to 133.30 markka. It is scheduled to publish January-June results next Thursday.
